annotations.title: Ad automation kill switch and per-account controls

description: The team's switch for EVERY ad automation on the account, and each ad account's own switch and daily raise limit. action get (default) reads them. action set with paused:true stops every ad rule at once (Meta and TikTok rules are switched off on the platform and remembered, Google Ads rules skip their runs); paused:false lets them run again, switching back on exactly the rules the switch stopped (if any can raise spend it asks for confirm:true after the user has seen the list). Add platform (meta, google_ads, tiktok_ads) and adAccountId to change ONE ad account: paused, and/or dailyRaiseLimit (the most rules may add to budgets there in a day, in its currency; null removes it; loosening needs confirm:true). Boost automations are paused one by one. The account owner or an admin only. Free.

confirm.description: true after the user agreed (resuming rules that can raise spend, or loosening a limit)

dailyRaiseLimit.description: most rules may add to budgets on that ad account in a day; null removes it
